description: Instances for the multi-period electric vehicle home health care routing and scheduling problem with uncertain travel times and service durations, from Yin et al. in Omega. The instances are in the authors' GitHub repository, whose description names the article and whose folders of 20, 25, 30 and 35 patients match the sizes the article's abstract reports; the data availability statement is in the full text, which needs publisher access.
